title: Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2002, Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2002, Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
